title: [3.0-beta11] AAPS/NSClient Synchronisation setting has Receive APS offline events. Is it needed ?
symptom: The user found a setting 'Receive APS offline events' in AAPS that specifies 'Accept APS offline events entered through NS or NSClient', but cannot find any way of giving APS offline events (Suspend Loop, Disconnect Loop etc.) from NSClient, questioning if the setting is unnecessary.
evidence_quote: However I cannot find any way of giving "APS offline events" (Suspend Loop, Disconnect Loop etc.) from NSClient.
